Food And Tobacco Roasting, Baking, And Drying Machine Operators And Tenders run heating and drying equipment in manufacturing plants. They set and monitor temperature, humidity, and time, sample products for doneness and moisture, clear lines between batches, inspect equipment, and protect batch consistency and compliance.

paragraphs: At handoff, operators review the process card and prior shift records. They preheat equipment to the required curve, then monitor temperature, humidity, and product color. Mid-process samples reveal moisture deviations that require damper or conveyor-speed adjustments. Changeovers require shutdown and cleaning, followed by equipment checks, operating records, quality sampling, and formal handoff.

This career rewards stability. A batch can weigh several thousand jin, and incorrect heat can destroy it. The work suits people who monitor equipment, understand instruments, care instinctively about food quality, and tolerate factory noise and repetition.
